Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, a frail but determined man. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Privilege To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live. Please Welcome The One And Only JACOB.

The room erupts in applause as Jacob takes the stage. He is handed the plaque, and with a hint of a smile, he accepts it.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the plaque from earlier sitting on his nightstand. He gazes at it, a mix of emotions on his face. Suddenly, his eyes wander to a dusty old book on his shelf. He picks it up, blowing off the dust.

JACOB
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

As he reads the words, his expression changes. His eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and confusion.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S MIND - NIGHT

Jacob's mind begins to unravel. He sees himself as a young man, browsing the internet in his youth. He comes across a forum post about Quantum Immortality.

JACOB (V.O.)
Quantum Immortality: The Theory That Our Reality Is Just One Of Many Parallel Universes. The Idea That Every Time A Decision Is Made, The Universe Branches Off Into A New Reality, Creating An Infinite Number Of Parallel Universes.

As Jacob reads on, his mind becomes consumed by the concept. He sees himself making different choices, living different lives. The possibilities are endless.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S MIND - LATER

Jacob's mind is a jumbled mess. He sees himself as a child, playing with his siblings. He sees himself as a young adult, falling in love. He sees himself as an old man, holding the plaque.

JACOB (V.O.)
But What If I'm Not Just One Person? What If I'm A Branch In A Tree Of Parallel Universes? What If I'm The Only One Who Remembers?

Jacob's mind begins to break down. He sees himself as a leaf blowing in the wind, lost in an infinite number of realities.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - LATER

Jacob lies in bed, his eyes wide with terror. He is no longer the 127-year-old man who received the world record. He is a lost soul, adrift in a sea of parallel universes.

JACOB
(whispering to himself)
I'm Not Alone. I'm Not Alone.

The camera zooms out as Jacob's mind continues to unravel. The screen fades to black.

FADE OUT.
